user.title: Connect to the Omada controller
user.description: Enter the local login details of your Omada controller (the TP-Link cloud is not used).

reconfigure.title: Change the connection to the controller
reconfigure.description: Change the IP, port, username or site without removing the integration: devices and entities are kept. Leave the password empty to keep the current one.

reauth_confirm.title: The controller rejected the login
reauth_confirm.description: The Omada controller ({host}) no longer accepts the saved username or password. Enter the current ones.

error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to the controller. Check the host and port.

abort.reconfigure_successful: Connection updated. The integration has been reloaded.
abort.reauth_successful: Login updated. The integration has been reloaded.
